item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `dspy.JSONAdapter` with a `DummyLM` subclass that declares `supported_params = {\"response_format\"}` and `supports_response_schema = True`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Defines two signatures: `Tight` with a typed `str` output and `Loose` with `dict[str, Any]` output."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Runs each prediction separately and reads `lm_*.history[-1][\"kwargs\"][\"response_format\"]` for offline inspection."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"The non-mapping case records a Pydantic model class, which matches the structured-output path rather than the JSON fallback."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Explicitly asserts the typed case is a `type` and a subclass of `pydantic.BaseModel`."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Explicitly asserts the open-ended mapping case records exactly `{\"type\": \"json_object\"}`."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
